verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI assistant like Claude, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or control that keeps user data out of model training. The pack covers apps, API, SSO, memory and pricing; the community items on request marking concern anti-distillation, not training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
